title: TranscriptFollowing
description: Answer to `transcript.follow`: the subscription exists, and what the conversation gains will arrive as `transcript.appended` with this `followId`. Nothing of the subscription arrives before this ack.

followId.description: The subscription. Its events carry it, and `seq` is monotonic per `followId`, from 1.

activity.description: What the conversation is doing now, by the rule of the listing: `activeElsewhere` is an estimate — something wrote to it recently —, never a fact about which client has it open.
